message:
Now let me find the DNS dictionary file that defines the packet structure:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>find /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/freeradius-server -name "dictionary" -path "*dns*" -o -name "dictionary.dns" | head && echo "---" && find /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/freeradius-server -name "*.dns" | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
